memex usage [--days 7] [--all]

  How the knowledge base is used, assembled from Claude Code and Codex conversation logs on this machine (kept locally,
  never committed or sent anywhere): how many questions, from which projects, the most-read pages, questions the
  knowledge base could not answer (candidates for new sources), pages nobody has opened in 30 days, and feedback received.
  --all also counts usage generated by the retrieval evaluation itself.
